analysis.title: Vistra - Watt's the Q3'26 Number for VST?
key_insights: BofA expects Vistra Q3'26 EBITDA of $2,151 mn, versus $1,581 mn in Q3'25 and Consensus of $2,173 mn, a $570 mn year-over-year increase.

The Q3 EBITDA walk: Retail +$80 mn on higher volumes and pricing, Texas +$317 mn on higher prices, more generation and reversal of Martin Lake outage losses, East +$188 mn on higher energy and capacity prices and the inclusion of Lotus, West flat, Corp & Other -$15 mn on higher O&M.
Investor focus is expected on the 2027/28 EBITDA build. For 2027 BofA sees a path to ~$7.5-7.6bn excluding Cogentrix and ~$8.0-8.1bn including it, with ~$200mn of Meta contribution layered in.
Lower ERCOT forwards and hedge pricing bias 2027 and 2028 EBITDA toward the lower end of the previously disclosed ranges.
For 2028 BofA sees EBITDA of ~$7.8-7.9bn excluding Cogentrix and ~$8.3-8.4bn including it, supported by the further Meta ramp and Comanche Peak contribution.
BofA does not expect VST to introduce a formal 2028 midpoint opportunity this quarter, so commentary on individual earnings building blocks matters more.

Key questions on ERCOT pricing: whether VST sees the recent weakness in 2027/28 forwards as transient, whether curves reflect expected market tightening, and how hedge activity affects earnings realization versus the screen.
Other focus areas: DC PPA ramps, PJM's RBP and IRAS proposals, large-load development in ERCOT, Batch Zero, and converting datacenter demand into contracting opportunities.
BofA reiterates Buy and lowers the PO to $194 from $196 after cutting the gas peer group multiple to 7.7x from 8.5x and adjusting EBITDA estimates.
BofA cuts FY27 EBITDA to $8,041 mn from $8,295 mn and FY28 to $8,648 mn from $8,817 mn, citing lower ERCOT forwards and hedge pricing. FY26 is unchanged at $7,208 mn.
BofA's 2027E and 2028E EPS are $12.04 and $14.27, against Bloomberg consensus of $10.13 and $11.75.
The $194 PO implies 37.4% total shareholder return from $141.73, including 36.9% price return and a 0.6% dividend yield.

market_movers.rationale: PO cut to $194 from $196 on lower ERCOT forwards, hedge pricing and a lower gas peer multiple. BofA sees upside after the stock's decline and expects datacenter co-location clarity in coming months.

sector_views.rationale: BofA sees significant upside in Vistra's base business after the stock's decline, with datacenter co-location clarity a potential catalyst.

earnings_insights: VST Q3'26 EBITDA, BofA estimate: $2,151 mn, vs consensus est $2,173 mn (Bloomberg) and Q3'25 actual $1,581 mn. Not yet reported as of 10/26.
VST Q3'26 EPS, BofA estimate: $0.41E, vs Q3'25 actual $1.74A.
VST FY26 EBITDA, BofA estimate: $7,208 mn vs consensus est $7,298 mn and guidance of $6,800-7,600 mn.
VST FY27 EBITDA, BofA estimate: $8,041 mn (prior $8,295 mn) vs consensus est $8,087 mn. FY28 BofA estimate $8,648 mn (prior $8,817 mn) vs consensus est $8,768 mn.
VST FY26/27/28 EPS, BofA estimates: $10.65/$12.04/$14.27, vs Bloomberg consensus est $8.57/$10.13/$11.75.
risk_factors: Changes to regulatory, political or legislative standards.
Wholesale power, natural gas and capacity price moves.
Competitive and regulatory change in retail, principally Texas.
Lower ERCOT forwards and hedge pricing could push 2027/28 results to the low end of the range.
